subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The activist is working really hard and was determined to ________ for this cause.

options.text: keep the wolf from the door

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. move heaven and earth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"move heaven and earth"** means to do everything possible to achieve something. (हर संभव प्रयास करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She will move heaven and earth to ensure her child gets the best education.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct phrase for the activist working really hard and determined to achieve something significant is **"move heaven and earth"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. move heaven and earth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Have feet of clay** (कमजोरी होना): A fundamental weakness or flaw in someone who is otherwise admired.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite his achievements, he had feet of clay that eventually led to his downfall.
 
 
 
• **Blow his own trumpet** (अपनी प्रशंसा करना): To boast or brag about one's own achievements.
 
 
• **Example: **He never misses a chance to blow his own trumpet about his successful projects.
 
 
 
• **Keep the wolf from the door** (गरीबी से बचाना): To have just enough money to avoid going hungry or to keep away poverty.
 
 
• **Example:** She took a part-time job to keep the wolf from the door.
